compatibility_note: AgentGuard Graph 1.0 freezes the current local evidence contract while retaining schema_version 0.1 in evidence and report payloads for backward compatibility with existing packs.
stable_contracts: CLI commands: scan, inventory, explain, compare, portfolio, validate, init, collect, doctor, demo
Doctor collection plan fields: actions, owner, file, target, reason, repair_text, exact_export, command, framework_checklists
Compare drift fields: evidence_manifest, remediation_plan, evidence manifest status/count deltas, remediation action/priority/owner/system/category deltas
Evidence manifest fields: schema_version, tool, generated_at, root, files, path, sha256, size_bytes, source_kind, schema_version
IAM analysis fields: summary, binding_coverage, unused_identities, unused_permissions, least_privilege_suggestions
Offline control analysis fields: summary, tool_inventory, generic_tools, agent_tool_controls, policy_control_gaps, prompt_security_boundaries, prompt_boundary_risks, roadmap

Policy analysis fields: summary, engines, evaluations, gaps, rule_risks; policy rule-risk types: broad_allow_high_risk, policy_rule_shadowed, conflicting_matching_decisions, unmatched_policy_rule, ineffective_control_rule
Policy evaluation import flags: --opa-policy, --rego-policy, --opa-eval, --cedar-policy, --cedar-eval
Privacy analysis fields: summary, data_exposures, classification_gaps, memory_retention, privacy_filters
Portfolio rollup fields: evidence-manifest status/drift counts and remediation action, priority, owner, system, and category rollups
Remediation plan fields: summary, owner_rollups, system_rollups, category_rollups, actions
Data classification import flags: --data-catalog-export, --dlp-export, --sensitivity-label-export, --table-classification-export
Runtime reconstruction fields: summary, event_quality, diagnostics, sessions, event_derived_paths, sessionless_events
Runtime import flags: --agent-trace-export, --approval-broker-export, --mcp-host-log, --ci-system-log, --cloud-audit-log
JSON report top-level fields required by schemas/findings.schema.json
Evidence quality labels: confirmed, supported, incomplete, weak
Path state labels: possible, supported, observed_partial, observed_full, observed_allowed, observed_blocked, unknown
Review decisions: block_launch, approve_with_conditions, needs_more_evidence, monitor_only, no_high_risk_paths_found
Accepted-risk statuses: open, accepted, acceptance_expired
Visibility gap priorities: critical_gap, high_gap, medium_gap, low_gap
Public score range: 0-100 with raw_points preserved for diagnostics
